artifacts.notes: Artifact PDF pages correspond to printed Acta pages for the registered range: artifact page 651 carries printed p. 651. The scan's optical text layer is a discovery aid; the cited pages were read in that rendered layer. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

No repository redistribution permission was established.

edition.notes: The complete 1970 volume. It carries the Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship's instruction Calendaria particularia of 24 June 1970 on printed pp. 651-663, cited by the Universal Norms on the Liturgical Year and the Calendar at n. 49.
